data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

**Target:** A **POXWALKERS** unit of yours that is a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** Once the attacking unit finishes fighting, roll a D6 for every model of the unit that those attacks **destroyed**. The attacking unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) for each 6. If the unit is still not destroyed once the attacking unit finishes fighting, enemy models this Stratagem destroys count, for **Curse of the Walking Pox**, as destroyed by attacks from models in the unit.
